title: hussain aa gaye hai hussain aa gaye hai
body:
hai jashne vilaadat me joshe masarrat -hussain aa gaye hai hussain aa gaye hai
ab islam mehfooz hai taa qayamat,-hussain aa gaye hai hussain aa gaye hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hai chehre se himmat ke tewar numaaya'n, na kyu kar ho koofe ki deewaar larza'n
ke ab dil me lekar ali ki shujaa'at,-hussain aa gaye hai hussain aa gaye hai
<<DIVIDER>>
na kyu kar ho qurban doure zamaani, fida ho rahi hai iram hi jawani
mila tujh ko sardaar aye baaghe jannat,-hussain aa gaye hai hussain aa gaye hai
<<DIVIDER>>
na ho kis tarah shor salle alaa ka, har ek simt hota hai ghul marhaba ka
na kyukar ho mehfil me ab joshe mid'hat,-hussain aa gaye hai hussain aa gaye hai
<<DIVIDER>>
falak se sada ghaib ki aa rahi hai, ke haqqaniyat ab mujassam hui hai
masarrat se ubhri hai mohre nabuwwat,-hussain aa gaye hai hussain aa gaye hai
<<DIVIDER>>
inhi ki kahani zamana kahega, bas ab hashr tak naam inka rahega
karenge ye dinya ke dilo par hukoomat,-hussain aa gaye hai hussain aa gaye hai
<<DIVIDER>>
jahannum me sota rahega jo shab bhar, sahar ko wo jaagega jannat me aakar
badal denge ek roz ye hur ki qismat,-hussain aa gaye hai hussain aa gaye hai
